_readme: Normalisation rules for import-books.mjs. Edit this file, not the script.
Lookups in 'category.map' and 'condition.map' ignore case and extra whitespace, so 'Adults', ' Adults' and 'adults' are the same key.
A value in the sheet that is not in a map stops the import with an error listing it, so nothing is silently guessed.
The raw sheet value is always kept in category_raw / condition_raw / genre_raw.

copies._rule: A blank 'Total Copies' cell becomes this many copies and the row is flagged in the report.

category._rule: category holds AUDIENCE only. Ranges map to their LOWEST audience (the youngest reader it is suitable for): 'Young Adults & Adults' -> 'Young Adults', 'Kids & Teens' -> 'Children'. Ranges spanning children to adults -> 'All Ages'. Genre-like values (Fiction, Translation, Education...) carry no audience information -> 'General'.

condition._rule: Good | Fair | Needs Repair | Poor. 'Medium' = Fair. Any note asking for repair or binding = Needs Repair (an action staff can take). 'Bad' with no repair note, or missing pages = Poor. Blank, or a value that is clearly not a condition (a publisher name typed into the column), = Good and the row is flagged.

price._rule: The column is Taka. Plain numbers are kept. A 'BDT'/'Tk'/'৳' prefix is stripped. A foreign-currency price (P = GBP, RS, RM, CAD, USD, $, £) is NOT converted: price becomes null (fines then fall back to the ৳200 default) and the row is listed in the report.

coverUrlRewrites._rule: Tried BEFORE the original URL when 'match' fits (regex, JS replace syntax). ds.rokomari.store resets every connection from here; rokbucket.rokomari.io serves the same files. cover_source_url always keeps the sheet's URL.

rowFixes._rule: Per-row corrections, keyed by book id. 'expect' (normalised values) or 'expectRaw' (sheet columns, as written) guards the fix: it is applied only if the sheet still holds those exact values, otherwise the import stops so the fix can be reviewed.

BK-1776.why: Bangla title and Bangla author are swapped in the sheet (English columns say 'Dune Messiah' / 'Frank Herbert').

BK-2918.why: Price typed as '48o' (letter o for zero).
